value.rationale: Omega was introduced as a quantitative Hilbert-space/isosceles-orthogonality invariant, and ell_p^2 is the canonical test family. The exponent p=3 is the first non-Hilbert odd integer case where the source's symmetric-plane formula becomes a genuinely nonquadratic cubic optimization. The exact value supplies a sharp benchmark, identifies the extremizing geometry, and demonstrates a reusable concavity-plus-polynomial mechanism for studying the still-unevaluated ell_p plane family; it is not a renaming, table recomputation, or arbitrary coordinate slice.
